old:
To show that an action is still happening or has been happening over time:

1. seguir + gerundio: 'still doing' (continuation):
• 'Sigo trabajando en el mismo colegio.' (I'm still working at the same school.)

2. llevar + tiempo + gerundio: 'have been doing for X time' (duration accumulated):
• 'Llevo tres meses viviendo en Madrid.' (I've been living in Madrid for three months.)
new:
To show that an action is still happening:

1. seguir + gerundio: 'still doing' (continuation):
• 'Sigo trabajando en la misma oficina.' (I'm still working at the same office.)

2. seguir sin + infinitivo: 'still not doing' (something still hasn't happened):
• 'Sigo sin entender.' (I still don't understand.)

You know *desde hace* from Unit 7: it says for how long. 'Sigo viviendo aquí desde hace un año.' (I'm still living here, and have been for a year.)
why: screen teaches llevar + tiempo + gerundio, a Unit 32 form (a2-perifrasisduracion-02 repeats it); recap desde hace instead
